# Mite, the swarmer: a plum beetle with a pale head and two brass horn nubs. 0.36 x 0.5 x 0.32 m. make_env.py.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.5451 0.3333 0.5020 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 0.7647 0.5333 0.5647 --no-slot
material new Horn --base-color 0.7451 0.5843 0.3608 --no-slot
material new Foot --base-color 0.2627 0.2039 0.3333 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1700 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.050 1.300 0.850
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 -0.0400 0.1700
material assign Shell
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1100 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.000 1.000 1.000
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 0.2000 0.1500
material assign Head
add mesh cube --name Horn0 --size 1 --location -0.0700 -0.2600 0.2600
scale 0.0700 0.0700 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Horn
add mesh cube --name Horn1 --size 1 --location 0.0700 -0.2600 0.2600
scale 0.0700 0.0700 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Horn
add mesh cube --name Foot0 --size 1 --location -0.1500 -0.1000 0.0350
scale 0.0900 0.1000 0.0700
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Foot1 --size 1 --location 0.1500 -0.1000 0.0350
scale 0.0900 0.1000 0.0700
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Foot2 --size 1 --location -0.1500 0.1000 0.0350
scale 0.0900 0.1000 0.0700
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Foot3 --size 1 --location 0.1500 0.1000 0.0350
scale 0.0900 0.1000 0.0700
apply --scale
material assign Foot
select all
shade flat
export mite.glb
